Member services of transaction_types (enum_multi, min_items 1, full_selection no_predicate, 04 2.5): production charges (rpt_ledger_entries.entry_type = charge and ledger_bucket <> non_production_charge). Contract-billing charges (ACBIL / ACBILO, ledger_bucket non_production_charge) belong to the Adjustment member, as the legacy journal prints them in Adjust (data card 2.12) [I, S-7]. Unticked = no service lines.

Member payments: entry_type in (patient_payment, insurance_payment). Payments only (Services and Adjustment unticked) = the vendor's tax receipt (title template 'Payment Receipt' is NEW, see the report section).

Member adjustments (legacy label singular 'Adjustment'): entry_type in (adjustment, refund, transfer, opening_balance), plus contract-billing charges (ledger_bucket non_production_charge) [I, S-7]. With all three members ticked the canonical value is all (no predicate), so no live line of the patient in the range is dropped.
